features.beginnerArea: Launching Pad learning area served by a magic carpet; beginner lesson tickets are limited to the Lunar Launch and Sunset Chair

source.note: Official homepage (fetched 2026-10-03): snowmaking "covers 100% of the terrain"; "During our night operating season, 97% of our trails have lighting." Beginner area (Launching Pad, Lunar Launch) from the official conditions/lift-ticket pages and earlier lessons-page research. Lodging/tubing/childcare not established.

character: Compact Finger Lakes ski area south of Canandaigua with about 1,200 ft (366 m) of vertical, large for western New York, on terrain that is fairly steep for the region. Snowmaking covers the whole mountain, most trails are lit for night skiing, and it hosts race and aerials training.
learning: Beginners start at the Launching Pad, a separate learning zone with a magic carpet. Beginner-only 2-hour group lessons run on weekends and holidays at 10am and 1pm; the package bundles a 4-hour lift ticket restricted to the Lunar Launch and Sunset Chair plus a 4-hour rental.

source.note: Opened Sat Dec 6, 2025 (weekends only at first, Comet Express with 3 trails; daily from mid-December). Closed Thu Apr 2, 2026: the official conditions page (last updated Apr 2, 2026) says "After 111 days on the mountain, Mother Nature has officially wrapped up" the season; RochesterFirst also reported it.

season.typicalText: Opened Sat Dec 6, 2025 (weekends at first, daily from mid-December) and on a Thursday around Nov 30, 2023 for its 59th season (date inferred from article dates); the 2024-25 opening date was not found. The 2025-26 season closed Thu Apr 2, 2026 after 111 operating days.
season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date on the official pages fetched 2026-10-03 (2026-27 season products on sale; Fall Sky Rides weekends Sep 12-Nov 1, 2026). OnTheSnow (third party) projected a 2026-12-11 opening in earlier research; a projection, not an announcement.
